blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from 14,000 feet with professional instructors or enroll in an Accelerated Freefall (AFF) course to learn to skydive and earn a license. The AFF course includes ground school and multiple jump levels with instructor assistance. Licensed jumpers can use the dropzone facilities and aircraft for their own jumps.
extraNote: No jumps when raining, very windy, or clouds lower than 9,000 feet · All refunds to credit or debit cards are subject to a 6% processing fee · $650 nonrefundable deposit for AFF first jump course · Waiver must be signed; must be 18 to sign waiver · At the dropzone, 30 minutes from Portland, Oregon · April 1st through the end of September for AFF training; tandem jumps year-round weather permitting
